policy: Preserve infrastructure failures separately from model/output failures. Generated artifacts were not edited to resolve these issues.

events.observed: skill://writing-skills and some routing URI reads resolved to absent plugin-cache files.
events.resolution: Read the known local repository skill files. Authors disclosed incidental wrapper exposure where it occurred.

events.observed: Eval @tool annotation inspection raised AttributeError for types.UnionType on Python 3.9.6.
events.resolution: Added an ephemeral compatibility sentinel for the helper's unused PEP 604 type check; registered the public development evaluator successfully.
events.scope: Reported through xd://report_issue; no repository runtime code was changed.

events.observed: tab.html() required an explicit selector despite no-argument use; the call failed before preserving the initial scrape records.
events.resolution: Used tab.html('html') and recorded successful real browser extraction.
events.scope: No invented HTML or extraction result was substituted.

events.observed: Two Python-launched and two JS-launched CLI attempts each timed out on the canonical SDK's 30-second goto request. The adapter had received the real requests.
events.initial_hypothesis: Keeping the outer JavaScript Eval context active would service callback dispatch.
events.hypothesis_result: Rejected: the JS-launched attempts also timed out.
events.resolution: Placed the HTTP adapter inside tab.run and used its direct Puppeteer page.goto/page.content methods; both unchanged CLIs then produced exact expected JSON.
events.remaining_inference: Nested browser-tool callback dispatch was the blocking boundary. The internal scheduler was not instrumented, so a deeper scheduler diagnosis is not claimed.

events.observed: Both replayed CLIs exited 0 and emitted correct JSON, but isDeepStrictEqual returned false. Prototype identity was false and canonical JSON equality was true for both outputs.
events.resolution: Changed only the replay grader to canonical JSON comparison and reran the saved harness successfully. The product artifacts and frozen expected values stayed unchanged.

events.observed: An author noticed later calls absent from an earlier parent-written checkpoint.
events.resolution: The evaluator kept all calls in its persistent log; parent saved the final 34-call, 170-sample corpus after author completion. No evidence loss was established and no response was rerun to hide an unfavorable result.
